About the Position

This postdoctoral project combines numerical optimisation and computational fluid dynamics for river dredging research.

Host and Funder

The selected organisation is the research host. FAPESP provides the fellowship funding; applicants should follow the project-specific eligibility and submission instructions in the official call.

About the Fellowship

This postdoctoral project combines numerical optimisation and computational fluid dynamics for river dredging research. Applicants need relevant quantitative research preparation and availability to work on the project, with applications sent directly to the specified academic contact.

Research Areas

  • Numerical optimisation
  • Computational fluid dynamics
  • Scientific computing

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPostdoctoral fellowship
Stipend / salaryFAPESP postdoctoral fellowship; amount not stated in checked advert

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Academic preparationRelevant PhD obtained less than seven years before the fellowship begins, subject to FAPESP exceptions.
Further conditionsRecent PhD in relevant quantitative discipline; application by email.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round30 November 2026
LocationBrazil

Contact

  • Email: elias@icmc.usp.br

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be sent to the contacts above or raised through the channel given on the official announcement page.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.fapesp.br/oportunidades/programacao-nao-linear-e-problemas-inversos-em-imagem/9900/

Source: fapesp.br - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 30 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

  1. Prepare a CV with publications, a research statement, a short interest letter and contact details for three academic referees.
  2. Email the application to elias@icmc.usp.br using the subject “Postdoctoral Position – Optimization and CFD for River Dredging”.
  3. Submit by 30 November 2026 and confirm availability for exclusive dedication to the project.

About São Paulo Research Foundation (FAPESP)

FAPESP funds research in São Paulo, Brazil, and publishes fellowship opportunities attached to research projects. Applicants follow the host project's submission instructions and the foundation's fellowship eligibility rules.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Read the official email application instructions

Application email: elias@icmc.usp.br
